title: support.tickets_daily, as Fabric Inbox emits it
description: B-211: the channel-agent standard's daily ticket counts (section 5.1), one event per agent address and closed UTC day on the server's events feed (/fabric/v1/events, list_agent_events), in the same fields a chat support channel sends, so one board reads both. A mail ticket is one message the agent took (one run); its outcome is ticketOutcomeOf's (workers/agents/ticket-outcome.ts). Sent with support.quality_daily, about a day after the day closes. Counts only: no sender, subject or text. workers/agents/tickets-daily.ts (ticketsDay).

channel.description: mail:<domain>:<local part> of the Cloudflare address, other characters as -.

arrived.description: Tickets whose message arrived on the day.

ended.description: Tickets that ended on the day: the cohort the outcome counts and the four shares cover.

openHandedOpen.description: Tickets open at the day's end in this state; a ticket that ended later is counted in the state it was in. Handed to a person by a sender or topic rule, or held by the safety check, with no signal of the person's answer.

openQuestionOpen.description: Tickets open at the day's end in this state; a ticket that ended later is counted in the state it was in. Held while the knowledge has no answer, retried until it has one or the final mark passes.

openAwaitingCustomer.description: Mail has no source for it: 0, and named in notMeasured. Mail agents ask the customer nothing.

openAwaitingApproval.description: Tickets open at the day's end in this state; a ticket that ended later is counted in the state it was in. A draft waiting for a person.

answered.description: Answered by the agent at the first try.

answeredAfterQuestion.description: Answered by the agent after the knowledge gained the answer or on a later try.

toPersonPolicy.description: Given to a person by policy: the hand-off reply of the policy, or a drafting agent's draft a person answered.

toPersonInability.description: Given to a person because the agent could not answer: a sending agent's draft a person answered.

handoffsClosedByPerson.description: Drafts a person is seen to have answered in the thread.

referred.description: The reply told the customer where to write; no signal from there comes back.

answeredElsewhere.description: A person replied in the thread before the agent acted.

noReplyOwed.description: The agent found nothing to answer.

customerSilent.description: Mail has no source for it: 0, and named in notMeasured.

expiredByDecision.description: Mail has no source for it: 0, and named in notMeasured.

expired.description: The customer got the safe reply in place of the answer.

unanswered.description: No answer reached the customer: a send that failed, or a hold, draft or hand-off past the final mark (30 days) with no closing reply.

firstReplyLate.description: Arrived tickets whose first reply (the waiting reply or the answer) left over 1 hour after the message arrived; a ticket with no reply yet is not counted.

promotions.description: Mail has no source for it: 0, and named in notMeasured.

fallbackTickets.description: Ended tickets answered with the safe reply.

notATicket.description: Messages of the day no one wrote to be answered (no sender, automatic, bulk, a copy answered from another address).

shareAnswered.description: A share of the ended tickets (null when none ended); the four overlap, as the standard says.

shareToPerson.description: A share of the ended tickets (null when none ended); the four overlap, as the standard says.

shareFallback.description: A share of the ended tickets (null when none ended); the four overlap, as the standard says.

shareUnanswered.description: A share of the ended tickets (null when none ended); the four overlap, as the standard says.

notMeasured.description: Fields mail has no source for: customerSilent, expiredByDecision, openAwaitingCustomer, promotions.
